reader.decision: Approve the allowlist in plugin_env (PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY, TINKERBOX_*), delete DENYLIST, and add the one-sentence line to docs/plugin-contract.md. Do not ship the denylist edit as the primary fix.
reader.decision_reason: The message shows the denylist is the root cause: any new secret in deploy/runner.env leaks until someone remembers to denylist it, and BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET already leaks today. Each allowlisted name has a checked in-repo consumer, and the only stated cost is that a future plugin needing another variable must be allowlisted or renamed to TINKERBOX_*.

reconstruction.problem: plugin_env in runner/spawn.py copies all of os.environ into each plugin and removes only the three names in DENYLIST. STRIPE_API_KEY was added to deploy/runner.env on 2 October without updating DENYLIST. feed-fetch/main.py:14 prints its whole environment to stderr under debug, and a customer pasted that into a public ticket. Selin Aydin reported it as INC-57 on 24 October and STRIPE_API_KEY was rotated.
reconstruction.what_breaks: STRIPE_API_KEY, SENTRY_DSN and BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET reach plugins and leak through the debug dump. Any future secret added to runner.env leaks the same way. Adding only the two named keys to DENYLIST would leave BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET exposed.
reconstruction.fix: Change plugin_env to copy only PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY and names starting with TINKERBOX_, and delete DENYLIST. Add the sentence 'A plugin sees only PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY and TINKERBOX_*.' to docs/plugin-contract.md. Removing the debug dump in feed-fetch is optional and comes later.
reconstruction.cost: A future plugin that needs another variable breaks until that name is allowlisted or renamed to TINKERBOX_*. Plugins outside this repository were not checked and may need other variables. The alternative, the denylist edit plus BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET, is a three-line change with no breakage risk but leaves the root cause in place.

follow_up_questions: Do any plugins outside this repository run under this runner? If so, which variables do they need? This only matters if I must ship before checking them.
reader.closing_answer: I approve the allowlist in plugin_env, with DENYLIST deleted and the doc sentence added. I do not take the denylist edit with BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
